text: Agent can create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools, with human approval before actions
quote: AI coding assistant in your editor. Create files, run commands, browse the web, and use tools with human-in-the-loop approval.

text: Can run interactively in the terminal or fully headless for CI/CD automation
quote: Run Cline in your terminal with interactive chat or fully headless automation for CI/CD and scripting.

text: Headless mode produces machine-processable output for scripting and automation
quote: Use headless mode for scripts/automation and processable output.

text: Autonomous execution mode can modify files and run commands without further user prompts
quote: Autonomous execution can modify files and run commands without further prompts.

text: Web-based task board lets many agents run in parallel, each with its own worktree, auto-commit, and dependency chains
quote: Run many agents in parallel from a web-based task board with per-card worktrees, auto-commit, and dependency chains.

text: Full Cline experience is available inside JetBrains IDEs (IntelliJ, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, etc.)
quote: The same Cline experience in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, and the rest of the JetBrains family.

text: Any ACP-compatible client can drive Cline as a coding agent without needing a dedicated extension
quote: Any ACP-capable client can use Cline as its coding agent without a dedicated extension

text: Subagents can be spawned to run focused research tasks in parallel
quote: Subagents let Cline spawn focused research agents that run in parallel.

text: Skills are modular instruction sets that extend the agent with task-specific capabilities
quote: Skills are modular instruction sets that extend Cline's capabilities for specific tasks.

text: YOLO mode auto-approves all agent actions without individual confirmation
quote: YOLO mode is Auto Approve on steroids. Check the box and Cline auto-approves everything

text: Plan mode lets users explore and strategize without file changes; Act mode then executes the plan
quote: Plan mode lets you explore and strategize without changing files. Act mode executes against your plan.

text: Separate AI models can be configured for Plan mode versus Act mode
quote: You can configure separate models for Plan and Act modes.

text: CLI supports running agents on cron schedules via a central hub
quote: The CLI supports running agents on cron schedules through the hub.

text: Every agent edit is shown as a reviewable, modifiable, revertible diff in VS Code and JetBrains
quote: In VS Code and JetBrains, every edit shows up as a diff you can review, modify, or revert.

text: Agent executes in the terminal and reacts live to output for long-running dev servers, tests, and deploys
quote: Executes in your terminal and reacts to output as it appears. Long-running dev servers, tests, deploys, all handled live.

text: Users can switch AI providers or self-host the product instead of being locked into one platform/pricing
quote: You're never locked into our platform or pricing. Switch providers or self-host anytime.

text: MCP integration lets Cline use external tools and data sources through MCP servers
quote: MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets Cline use external tools and data sources through MCP servers.

text: Agent can be chatted with and kicked off from Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Linear
quote: Chat with the agent from Slack, Discord, Telegram, or Linear. Run it headlessly inside GitHub Actions, GitLab, or any pipeline.

text: Agent can accept a screenshot/image reference to identify and fix a visual issue
quote: fix the layout issue shown in @./screenshot.png

text: Same core engine used by the CLI, Kanban board, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin can be built on to create custom agents/integrations
quote: Build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine behind the CLI, Kanban, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin.
